scenes.text: The ChatGPT prompt behind a 16-year-old's *$150K* in Amazon sales

scenes.title: What he *actually* did
lines: Ethan Alexander, 16, had ChatGPT write a Python script that filtered out products that would not sell. Source: Entrepreneur, July 15, 2026.
His exact prompt is not public. This is our working version of it.

scenes.prompt: Write a Python script that reads products.csv (cost, Amazon price, sales rank, reviews) and keeps only items with 30%+ margin after a 15% fee, rank under 50,000 and 100+ reviews. Save them to keepers.csv.
reply: It loads products.csv, works out margin after the 15% referral fee, and drops anything that misses your three rules.
scenes.caption: No coding needed. *Paste, run, sort.*

scenes.title: Where the *numbers* come from
lines: Cost: your receipt. Price, rank, reviews: the Amazon listing, or the free Keepa browser extension.
Start with one Walmart or Target aisle. Twenty products. Let the script pick the five to try.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Resale margins get thin fast. Start with $100 to $500 and track every fee.
Check Amazon's restricted brands list before you buy anything.

scenes.text: Save this. *Try one aisle* this week.
